scope: Independent Fortress low-speed trials; no physical motion or onboard real-time acceptance

forward.calibration_scope: Simulation joints already use URDF coordinates; real encoder/mechanical calibration is not certified.

final_diagnostics.controller_request_semantics: controller command-interface request; not final motor packet or measured torque; hardware may scale/disable it
final_diagnostics.joy_request_snapshot: latest buffered Joy at diagnostic sampling; may postdate the control update snapshot; not an accepted mode

limitations: One run per gain profile; asynchronous solver timing and startup variation remain confounders
Friction/delay are assumed joint-side stress parameters, not hardware identification
Joint budget and errors reconstructed at approximately 10 Hz; missed transients remain possible
Physics pose summary uses 100 Hz independent odometry and diagnostic mode labels
Directional/stability test passes do not establish accurate velocity tracking
Passive, calibration and FAULT gains were never unified
Raw logs and trial orchestration remain ignored

conclusion.reason: Unified active gains passed the tested movements but did not demonstrate a general improvement: forward distance error increased from 18.2% to 30.5% in these single runs; joint tracking, body height and budget results require separate interpretation
conclusion.scope: One run per profile, no hardware validation; no claim of statistical significance or unique root cause
